title: Doubling & Halving
summary: Double and halve numbers in your head, use doubles you know for near doubles like $6 + 7$, and make multiplying easier by doubling one number and halving the other.
bigIdeas: Doubling means adding a number to itself: double $8$ is $8 + 8 = 16$.
Halving undoes doubling: half of $16$ is $8$.
tips: Double tens and ones separately: double $34$ is double $30$ and double $4$: $60 + 8 = 68$.
$6 + 7$ is a near double: double $6$ is $12$, and one more is $13$.
Half of $70$: half of $60$ is $30$, half of $10$ is $5$, so $35$.
Times $4$ is double, then double again: $4 \times 13 = 26$ doubled $= 52$.
